text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1767543210 - Private VPC cross-region ILB routing errors detected. Severity: P1. Affected: Redwood Private (VPC) deployments in us-west1 <-> us-east1 and europe-west1. Symptoms: intermittent 502/504 on model endpoints, long tail latency for admin/control-plane ops. Auto-alerting triggered at 2026-03-15T05:14:12Z. Paging SRE rotation now. https://status.gcp.google.com/ (see compute.googleapis.com incidents)

sre_rohan: ack, I'm on it. pulling recent router / healthcheck logs and running diag. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform. posting initial findings in a sec. (reacted :eyes:)

maria_ps: seeing burst of 500/503s from compute.googleapis.com in our control-plane logs starting ~05:12 UTC. Errors concentrated on cloud-router and global-forwarding-rule APIs. Outbound calls from Private control plane to GCP are getting TLS handshake timeouts and 502 responses. Likely third-party issue on GCP control plane. https://status.cloud.google.com/incidents/compute -> there is an active incident mentioning "network control plane" (gcp-status-bot forwarded link)

dan_runtime: confirmed ILB healthcheck probe failures from internal LB -> model pod IPs for cross-region paths. Local (us-west1) regional ILBs are fine; cross-region forwarding rules are dropping. Example traceroute (sanitized):

```
traceroute to 10.240.5.22 (10.240.5.22), 30 hops max
 1  10.128.0.1 0.9 ms 0.7 ms 0.6 ms
 2  * * *
 3  35.191.10.23 12 ms 11 ms *
 4  * * *
```

edgier results for cross-region probes, matching 5xx from compute API.

eng_nat: root cause likely GCP control-plane rate-limiting / partial outage affecting cross-region forwarding and Cloud Router route updates. Customers with Private deployment routing relying on global forwarding rules (cross-region) will see degraded path selection. Two quick mitigations we can attempt:
- 1) Apply regional failover: reconfigure ILB forwarding to prefer regional endpoints (keepalive switch) as emergency fallback.
- 2) Toggle emergency route advertisement to force regional egress (BGP tweak) for affected customer VPCs.

I'll prepare a minimal `gcloud` snippet to advertise regional route prefixes as a temporary fallback. Requires customer consent for Private deploys (we have emergency SLA).

eng_nat:
```
# TEMP fallback: update forwarding rule to regional endpoint (example)
gcloud compute forwarding-rules set-target FORWARDING_RULE_ID --region us-west1 --target-pools regional-pool-id

# Or push emergency BGP announcement if we manage VRF
gcloud compute routers update ROUTER_ID --region us-west1 --asn 65000 --bgp-advertised-routes net:10.240.0.0/16
```

sre_rohan: doing quick smoke tests on a non-prod customer to validate regional fallback. If successful, we'll escalate to prod but we need Prod/CS approval before touching customer VPCs.

prod_abe: prioritize contacting top 5 enterprise Private customers first (they have dedicated capacity). CS will prepare comms. We should aim for a short transparent update within 20 mins and a mitigation window estimate.

cs_ellie: drafting customer update now. Draft for approval:

"We are investigating an issue impacting some Private deployments' cross-region networking due to a GCP control-plane incident. Some traffic may be routed suboptimally or see timeouts when reaching model endpoints. We are working with GCP and will provide mitigation updates shortly. If you see any production impact, please reply and include request IDs."

sre_rohan: escalated to GCP P1 support, case 20260315-1287. Logged control-plane traces + packet captures, asked for ETA and if they can honor our emergency route adjustments without further degradation.

gcp-status-bot: GCP Incident 98765432 - Network Control Plane - Ongoing. Visible impact to global forwarding and cloud-router APIs. Engineers investigating. (link: https://status.cloud.google.com/98765432)

maria_ps: note: we have a backlog of BGP updates queued in our control-plane agent due to repeated API 5xx; pushing more updates will likely hit further rate-limits. Recommend limit changes to one-off emergency changes, then throttle.

dan_runtime: if we try the regional-fallback, we should also flip the model routing config to prefer regional replicas (runtime config flag) to reduce cross-region calls. I have a canary playbook: /runbooks/incidents/runtime-crossregion-fallback.md (internal link)

eng_nat: performing the non-prod test now. Canary shows regional fallback reduces 5xx -> 0/100 for healthchecks in 2m. Will prepare runbook steps for prod cutover (requires ~3min per customer to patch forwarding rules, cert-checks, and a quick rollback plan).

prod_abe: approve contacting customers with ETA 45m for mitigation window. CS to post planned actions and expected brief degrade during cutover. Engineering, please coordinate exact times and provide exact roll-forward/rollback commands.

cs_ellie: posted initial customer message to priority list and created a Zendesk incident for affected accounts. Template updated with case link and our status page pointer. (reacted :white_check_mark:)

sre_rohan: preparing handoff to night SRE (samir_night). Leaving checklist in thread. Current status:
- GCP P1 open, waiting ETA.
- Non-prod regional-fallback validated.
- Prod rollout plan drafted, awaiting CS ok to proceed.
- Action owner for rollout: eng_nat.

Checklist attached (inline):
1) Confirm customer opt-in (for Private managed routing) or use emergency SLA-authorized changes.
2) Schedule 1-min maintenance window per VPC.
3) Execute forwarding-rule set-target and runtime config switch.
4) Monitor healthchecks (expect improvement) and check control-plane error rates.
5) If error-rate increases, rollback forwarding-rule to previous target.

sre_rohan: handing off; samir, take lead for night watch. I'll be reachable for escalation. (reacted :pray:)

samir_night: ack, taking over. I'll start by replaying the runbook and validating all queued customer consent flags. Please post the final prod rollout time once decided.

eng_nat: prod rollout window set to 05:55 UTC for top-3 customers; update will be ~3m each. Will post per-customer run logs here as I do them.

sre_rohan: after rollout, please document any deviations and attach packet captures + timestamps. We'll prepare post-incident summary and customer impact list.

prod_abe: noted. We'll prepare external postmortem and customer-facing summary once incident is resolved.

oncall-bot: reminder: escalate to oncall-manager if >60m without resolution. Current elapsed: 30m. (reacted :alarm_clock:)

sre_rohan: closing my shift to let samir handle ops; leaving monitoring alerts in place. next update from samir or eng_nat.
